title: Hawksbill Gap EVA Time Budget Analysis

planning_assumptions.status: All parameters are operational planning assumptions for mission feasibility analysis.

locomotion_model.citation: Tobler, W. (1993) NCGIA Technical Report 93-1; Apollo/Artemis analog field data
locomotion_model.slope_definition: S = dz / dd (vertical elevation change / horizontal great-circle distance)
locomotion_model.optimal_slope_description: -5% grade (slight downhill ~ -2.86 deg) yields maximum velocity

science_stops.rationale: Standard analog field task allocation for high-resolution scale photography, orientation notes, and contact inspection.
option_a_stops: Wildcat Ridge (15 min); Skinner Ridge observed via standoff

nominal_budgets.rationale: 60–90 min nominal excursions leave sufficient portable life support system (PLSS) reserves (O2, battery, water sublimation) for contingency.

terrain_data.source: USGS TRN HiRISE Digital Terrain Model (1 m grid resolution, DeltaGeoid vertical reference)

planning_assumptions.disclaimer: Planning assumptions only. Does not replace certified suit life support system telemetry, consumables tracking (O2, battery, sublimator water), terrain trafficability, or real-time astronaut physiological monitoring.

comparative_analysis.trade_off_title: Route A vs Route B Time Budget Trade-off
comparative_analysis.scientific_gain: Visiting Skinner Ridge in Option B requires +87.27 m of walking (+2.66 min walk time) and +15.00 min field observation time (+17.66 min total excursion time). This extra time enables direct macro inspection of the bedrock contact interface, resolving whether the Skinner Ridge block is in-place bedrock or upper Rockytop float. Option A avoids the extra 17.66 min but leaves the contact uninspected and unresolved.

budget_feasibility.nominal_60_min: Both routes are comfortably within the nominal 60.0 min budget (Option A margin: +37.00 min; Option B margin: +19.34 min).
budget_feasibility.extended_90_min: Both routes are comfortably within the extended 90.0 min budget (Option A margin: +67.00 min; Option B margin: +49.34 min).
budget_feasibility.conservative_30_min: Option A is within the 30.0 min conservative budget (+7.00 min margin), whereas Option B exceeds the 30.0 min conservative limit by 10.66 min (OVER_BUDGET).
